mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy shifts toward accommodation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market weakness that reduces corporate profit growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through stronger earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with both HOUST and RSAFS rising >0.5% MoM, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.04 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS rising for 3+ consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and increase in residential construction (HOUST) indicates supply-demand mismatch that creates inflationary pressures and reduces corporate margins, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO < 100 and HOUST > 0.5% MoM, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.04 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%) supports corporate earnings expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during economic expansions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with GDPC1 growth > 2.0%, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.05 over 2-year window.
